Hi Olivia — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps related to the data handling items we covered (PII in prompts/outputs, retention, logging, residency):

What we committed on the call:
- Default behavior: prompt inputs and generated outputs are NOT persisted to long-term storage by default for hosted customers unless "persisted logs" is enabled.
- Ephemeral runtime: KV caches and transient session state live in-memory for the duration of the session (typically <2 hours) and are not written to durable object storage unless you opt-in.
- Route-level controls: you can disable prompt logging per API key/route to ensure nothing is collected for sensitive routes.
- Residency options: EU and US regional persistence available; we can pin persisted logs to EU region if required by your compliance team.

Ask / next steps:
1) I attached a compact matrix (Redwood_PromptData_Handling_Matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps "what gets stored", default TTLs, and how to configure for dedicated/private deployments — can you please share with your security & legal (I cc'd legal) and flag any required adjustments?
2) If HaleThera wants zero persistence for the demo, we’ll provide an API key configuration that disables logging and preserves ephemeral-only behavior.
3) If you want an auditable trail, we can enable persisted session logs and set TTLs — typical defaults noted in the matrix.

I’ll follow up with a short summary with explicit TTL numbers (requested by your security team) in a separate email in the next 24 hours.

Best,

Hi Olivia — answers below (summarized, and I attached the same matrix with the numeric defaults filled in). Short version first, then specifics:

Short answers:
- Default TTLs (hosted): transient KV cache = session-only (max 2 hours), short-term persisted logs (if enabled) = 30 days, audit/export logs = 365 days.
- Enterprise / Dedicated options: TTLs are configurable; common enterprise commitment is 90 days for persisted prompts/outputs and 3+ years for audit logs (we can extend to 7 years under contract).
- Redaction: yes — route-level server-side redaction hooks are available (pre-ingest processors) and can run either via our managed redaction or a customer-supplied Lambda preprocessor in your VPC for Private deployments.
- EU residency: when you pin persisted logs to an EU region we also pin snapshot backups and audit logs to the same region; cross-region replication is disabled by default for pinned datasets (we document this in the matrix).

Detailed breakdown (from the matrix):
- KV cache (in-memory): lifespan = session only, default max = 2 hours. Not durable. No backups.
- Transient persisted logs (opt-in per route): default TTL = 30 days (hosted). These are stored in region you select; encryption at rest with Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) available for Dedicated/Private.
- Long-term audit/export logs: default retention = 365 days; exportable on-demand to your S3/GCS. For Dedicated/Enterprise we can negotiate 3–7 year retention and special access controls.
- Backups & snapshots: if you pin a dataset to EU, backups are created daily and kept in the same region by default; we can provide an attestation for backup residency.
- Redaction & masking: built-in regex and ML-based redaction pipelines (configurable). For maximum control we recommend the VPC preprocessor option so raw content never touches managed durable storage.
- Access & key management: KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). Access logs recorded in our audit trail; customer admin roles are required for key release.

Operational controls you should know:
- Route-level "no-capture" toggle that prevents any storage of request/response for that API key.
- Per-deployment defaults: Hosted (30d), Dedicated (configurable, typical 90d), Private (customer-managed).
- Audit log export: daily export to customer bucket available; SLA for exports is part of Dedicated contracts.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Send the attached matrix to your DPO & Legal; note the EU backup residency clause on row 3.
2) If HaleThera wants a demo with zero-persistence behavior, reply "ZERO-PERSIST-DEMO" and I'll provision a route with logging disabled.
3) If you'd like a short security workshop with Soojin (our security lead) and your DPO, we can schedule 45 minutes this week.

I also attached a one-page evidence pack we can share with procurement if helpful. Happy to iterate.

Thanks,
Marcus

Hi Olivia — quick note from security: we can confirm the following operational points so your DPO can rely on them in the short term:

- When EU-pinned persistence is selected, daily snapshots and backups are retained in-region and cross-region replication is turned off by default. We will provide a signed attestation for backups and snapshot residency.
- For redaction, the VPC-preprocessor pattern guarantees raw prompt text never hits our managed durable storage; it is processed inside your network and only sanitized derivatives are sent to Redwood.
- Audit logs are immutable in our system; for Dedicated customers we provide export to your bucket and a retention configuration.

Happy to join a call with your DPO to walk through the attestation and the VPC preprocessor design.
